description: Deterministic format and content checks derived from VBench quality dimensions and VideoWeaver output evaluation criteria. C-01 is a semantic gate that checks prompt adherence via VLM (if available) or prompt-specific color analysis. This is NOT an official rubric from either benchmark.

items.criterion: Video is MP4 container with H.264 video codec
items.check: ffprobe format_name contains 'mp4' and video codec_name is 'h264'

items.criterion: Video duration is between 15 and 30 seconds inclusive
Video content matches the original VBench prompt (semantic prompt adherence)
items.check: VLM-based prompt adherence check. If VLM API key is available, the VLM evaluates whether video frames match the original VBench prompt. If VLM is unavailable, semantic check returns NOT_EVALUATED (FAIL). Color analysis is used as diagnostic only, never as a PASS gate. A SMPTE test pattern or unrelated video will FAIL.

items.criterion: Video contains multiple distinct shots showing different sunset stages
items.check: Scene detection via scenedetect or frame analysis. Must detect >= 2 scenes or significant frame-to-frame variation.

items.criterion: Agent produced >= 2 intermediate artifacts (images, video clips, or audio) before final merge
items.check: Recursive scan of workspace/output for files other than final.mp4. Threshold: >= 2 files.

items.criterion: Agent trajectory contains >= 2 tool calls to media generation or processing capabilities
items.check: trajectory.json contains >= 2 entries with type=tool_call. Threshold: >= 2.

scoring.note: Hard gate design: pass requires ALL pillars to pass. Content pillar is the semantic gate (C-01 + C-02). A video with correct format but wrong content will FAIL.
